pairs.evidence: lib/imaging/router.ts:90 The dev generate plan puts agy, which is unpriced and was only checked to work live, ahead of Google, the measured cost-per-usable winner, so for unreferenced requests the plan order is a belief and not a measurement, even though the router mechanics (steer, trail, refusal walk, pre-call gate, plan-top reachability) all follow the standard.

techniques.evidence: lib/imaging/router.ts:90 The chokepoint and the prefer/avoid asymmetry (orderFor, noAlternative) conform, but a new vendor entered AHEAD of the incumbent with no usable-output comparison, which breaks the 'enters behind the incumbent' rule.

lib/imaging/router.ts:84 The Google-vs-Leonardo grid (7/30 vs 26/30, $0.110 vs $0.052 per usable) is recorded above the plan row, but the row's top entry is justified by a live check rather than cost per usable; the pricing table leaves agy unpriced, so it has no figure at all. The pre-call gate (reserve before walk) does conform.
lib/imaging/errors.ts:112 Refusal is its own kind and reroutable; failed/bad-response/over-budget/invalid-request throw. The comment explains why each was left out.

lib/imaging/router.ts:400 Four elimination kinds pushed to the trail as each decision is made. The trail lands on provenance, in the thrown error (the constraint outranks the vendor error at lines 476-488) and in logCall.

lib/imaging/pricing.ts:10 Every row has a source and a checked date. Rates are bound to atSize. The vendor-reported/estimated/unpriced basis travels on Provenance, and the pre-call estimate takes the dearest rate.
lib/imaging/router.ts:177 Plan-top reachability is reported per window, and budget.ts declares a floor band with an underFloor report that is never enforced.

lib/imaging/types.ts:33 GenerateRequest pins the aspect but carries no size or stage field. Pixel size is one table per aspect, and Google's image_size is one env knob, so filmstrip drafts (count>1) and winners render at the same size.

techniques.evidence: lib/text/router.ts:93 One table per posture (local and cloud), with turn classes as the capability vocabulary. reason() is the only entry point, and the cloud row is deliberately short, with a reason given.
lib/text/router.ts:426 The descent trail is kept on provenance, in the final error and in logTurn. Rung and transport travel with every answer.

lib/text/providers/google.ts:325 A 200 that carries a safety block is raised as reroutable 'refused'. An empty answer becomes bad-response, which is a failure but does not re-route, so it is not a false success (see notes).
lib/text/pricing.ts:3 Cloud rows are unpriced on purpose, with reasons and checked dates. The CLI's own total_cost_usd is booked as vendor-reported.

pairs.registryProposal: The subject's scope is image and video generation, yet its techniques (plan, trail, refusal hop) bind just as cleanly to an LLM reasoning chain. Either state that the subject covers any generative chain, or point text routing at model-routing explicitly.
